## Load trained ML models

```{r}
## Change this path if your Rdata file is saved somewhere else
model_rdata_file <- "GSE101764_ML_training_110DMRs/GSE101764_ML_training_3models_110DMRs.Rdata"

if (!file.exists(model_rdata_file)) {
  stop(paste0("Model Rdata file not found: ", model_rdata_file))
}

load(model_rdata_file)

## Check whether the three trained models are loaded correctly
exists("model_glmnet")
exists("model_rf")
exists("model_svm")
```

## Extract cross-validated predictions
```{r}
get_best_predictions <- function(model) {
  
  pred <- model$pred
  best <- model$bestTune
  
  for (cn in colnames(best)) {
    pred <- pred[pred[[cn]] == best[[cn]], , drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  return(pred)
}

pred_glmnet <- get_best_predictions(model_glmnet)
pred_rf <- get_best_predictions(model_rf)
pred_svm <- get_best_predictions(model_svm)

head(pred_glmnet)
head(pred_rf)
head(pred_svm)
```

## Build ROC objects
```{r}
## Tumor is treated as the positive class.
## The column Tumor contains the predicted probability of being Tumor.

roc_glmnet <- roc(
  response = pred_glmnet$obs,
  predictor = pred_glmnet$Tumor,
  levels = c("Normal", "Tumor"),
  direction = "<",
  quiet = TRUE
)

roc_rf <- roc(
  response = pred_rf$obs,
  predictor = pred_rf$Tumor,
  levels = c("Normal", "Tumor"),
  direction = "<",
  quiet = TRUE
)

roc_svm <- roc(
  response = pred_svm$obs,
  predictor = pred_svm$Tumor,
  levels = c("Normal", "Tumor"),
  direction = "<",
  quiet = TRUE
)

auc_glmnet <- as.numeric(auc(roc_glmnet))
auc_rf <- as.numeric(auc(roc_rf))
auc_svm <- as.numeric(auc(roc_svm))

auc_summary <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Elastic-net", "Random Forest", "Radial SVM"),
  AUC = c(auc_glmnet, auc_rf, auc_svm)
)

auc_summary
```

## Prepare ROC data for plotting
```{r}
roc_to_df <- function(roc_obj, model_name, auc_value) {
  
  data.frame(
    FPR = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
    TPR = roc_obj$sensitivities,
    Model = paste0(model_name, " (AUC = ", sprintf("%.3f", auc_value), ")"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

roc_df <- bind_rows(
  roc_to_df(roc_glmnet, "Elastic-net", auc_glmnet),
  roc_to_df(roc_rf, "Random Forest", auc_rf),
  roc_to_df(roc_svm, "Radial SVM", auc_svm)
)

head(roc_df)
```

## ROC curve comparison
```{r}
p_roc <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = FPR, y = TPR, color = Model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Cross-validated ROC curves in GSE101764",
    x = "False positive rate (1 - Specificity)",
    y = "True positive rate (Sensitivity)",
    color = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.68, 0.20),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13)
  )

p_roc
```

## Sensitivity and specificity at optimal cutoff
```{r}
get_optimal_metrics <- function(roc_obj, pred_df, model_name) {
  
  ## Optimal cutoff based on Youden index
  opt <- coords(
    roc_obj,
    x = "best",
    best.method = "youden",
    ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"),
    transpose = FALSE
  )
  
  cutoff <- as.numeric(opt["threshold"])
  sensitivity <- as.numeric(opt["sensitivity"])
  specificity <- as.numeric(opt["specificity"])
  
  ## Predicted class based on optimal cutoff
  pred_class <- ifelse(pred_df$Tumor >= cutoff, "Tumor", "Normal")
  pred_class <- factor(pred_class, levels = c("Tumor", "Normal"))
  
  obs_class <- factor(pred_df$obs, levels = c("Tumor", "Normal"))
  
  cm <- caret::confusionMatrix(
    pred_class,
    obs_class,
    positive = "Tumor"
  )
  
  data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    AUC = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj)),
    Cutoff = cutoff,
    Sensitivity = sensitivity,
    Specificity = specificity,
    Accuracy = as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"]),
    Balanced_Accuracy = as.numeric(cm$byClass["Balanced Accuracy"]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

performance_table <- rbind(
  get_optimal_metrics(roc_glmnet, pred_glmnet, "Elastic-net"),
  get_optimal_metrics(roc_rf, pred_rf, "Random Forest"),
  get_optimal_metrics(roc_svm, pred_svm, "Radial SVM")
)

performance_table[, 2:ncol(performance_table)] <- round(
  performance_table[, 2:ncol(performance_table)],
  3
)

performance_table
data.table::fwrite(
  performance_table,
  file = "GSE101764_ROC_optimal_cutoff_performance_table.csv"
)
```
